name: Stealing Ironforge's Flame
label: Quest
description: Stealing Ironforge's Flame: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This flame, stolen from the heart of Ironforge itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Talespinner might know more...

clips.title: Progress
paras: You're practically glowing, traveler. What do you have there?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This hearty flame must be from the halls of Ironforge; it's as stalwart as the dwarves themselves. A fine catch, friend. If I had the fires of the other cities... Ah, but never mind. Here is your payment.
